1. RSA Common Factor Attack:

- Steps:

  2. Calculate GCD(n1, n2) to find the common prime factor p

from crypto_commons.rsa.rsa_commons import common_factor_factorization, modinv

def decrypt_common_factor(ciphertexts, moduli, e):
    # Find common factors between moduli
    for na, nb, p in common_factor_factorization(moduli):
        index_a = moduli.index(na)
        index_b = moduli.index(nb)
        
        # Calculate private keys
        qa = na // p
        qb = nb // p
        
        # Calculate totients

        plaintext_a = pow(ciphertexts[index_a], da, na)
        plaintext_b = pow(ciphertexts[index_b], db, nb)
